# Haki Productions

> Creative media agency in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. Street, punk and cultured.
> Human-made content, brand identity, fashion production, music, publishing and event media.
> One crew, five fronts. Every piece of work is made by people, not generated.

## What Haki Productions does

- **The Engine** — monthly content retainer. One shoot day a month, six vertical videos, one edited photo set, scripts, hooks and captions, plus a monthly content plan.
- **The Launch** — one campaign, fully produced: hero film, five vertical cutdowns, eight campaign photos, launch copy.
- **The Identity** — logo suite, colour and type system, brand guide, social templates.
- **The Press Kit** — bio, positioning copy, edited photos, press highlights, PDF kit for artists, athletes and brands.
- **The Recap** — event coverage: recap film, vertical cutdowns, edited photos, delivered within days.
- **Gatekeepers Mag** — in-house editorial title.
- **Fashion and merch production**, **music releases**, **event activation** — scoped per brief.

## Pricing

Projects are scoped per brief. The monthly retainer starts at €1,950 per month.
Every quote lists deliverables, timeline and revision rounds before work starts.
